lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That's everything I can tell you.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... This is the first time I've been able to talk so freely to someone.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Whatever decision you make, I'll accept it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We've been in here a while. I'll try and find us a way out.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You wait here for a sec...
Leaving Elysion and going to the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It came from over there, right?
The sound came from beyond a wall piled high with metal crates.
It sounds like Jackal and Viper.
E.H. grabs me by the collar and quickly pulls me away from the wall.
I quickly cover my head and duck.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I figured you'd come right away.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Sorry about that. This place is used for cold storage, so the temperature weakened the signal.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Plus, we had to make a short pit stop somewhere.
Cold storage? No wonder it felt so cold in here...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I guess they figured this was the best place to jam any possible tracking signals.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Check the inside of your sleeve.
I feel along the inside of my sleeve.
I detach a small cube, no bigger than my pinky nail.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: When you gave me that little boost earlier, remember?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe... Now, as a sign of our trust and commitment,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We were escorting you through the Outer Rim. We had to take certain precautions.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: And what do you know, it helped us find you!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I know I technically failed to protect you as I'd promised,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: but... I did come and save you, so... we're good, right?

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Good? I don't really get what you mean, but Commander is good!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh, and by the way, we caught the guy who did this.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yeah, that pit stop I mentioned earlier.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: He'd actually been upstairs, eavesdropping on us.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: We subdued him, though. Wanna see?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Are you sure? It might be dangerous. Maybe you should wait outside with Jackal.
I'd like to hear what he says. I'm involved in this too, after all.
I want to know why he did it.
With Viper and Jackal leading the way, we go upstairs.
A man is there, bound to a pillar and gagged. He glares at us.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Viper, can you remove the gag?
Viper approaches the man and removes the gag.

lines.speaker: enterheavenman
lines.text: Hmph... What're you even doing that for? You should just kill me.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: You've got a good memory for a traitor.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I didn't know you were still alive.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Last time I looked for you, I couldn't find you anywhere, so I thought you were dead.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: Why would I show my face to a Central Government lapdog?

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: You'd only try and get me to quit Heavenly Ascension anyway.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: I couldn't believe you'd become a government lapdog! You were our boss!

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: Why didn't you die back then?

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: During the attack on the Ark, you should've just let yourself get blown up along with that surface elevator!
You don't have to listen to this, E.H.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yeah, there's nothing to hear that you haven't already heard.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: If you'd died without becoming a Nikke...!

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: Then I wouldn't feel so betrayed!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You saw for yourself the horror we inflicted in the name of terrorism.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: as soon as the wrong methods are used, the message loses all meaning.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: A name can be branded into history, but our cause lost all its legitimacy.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We dressed them up under the name of a human rights movement, but all those terrorist attacks...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: were nothing more than violent crimes.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Crimes that brought death and destruction on a whole lot of innocent people.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We can realize that we were wrong and regret it all we want, but there's no changing the wrongs we committed.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: It doesn't ease the pain that the victims suffered.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: There needs to be someone who has to atone,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: because pain and sin don't ever go away.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: All those crimes we committed were in the name of Heavenly Ascension,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: so I thought it was only right that I take responsibility for them.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Yeah... I'm the one who started it all.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I'm the one who founded Heavenly Ascension, who failed to stop Crow and the hard-liners,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and who ultimately decided to go to that meeting where so many of our people died.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I realized that since I'm the one who started all this, I should be the one to end it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: But by the time I made that decision, my body was already dying.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That's the reason I became a Nikke.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I wanted to have more time to atone for what we did.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I think you should move on, too...

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: In that case... let me ask you one last question.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: has there ever been a time, even just once, when you regretted coming to the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: Just answer the question. Do you regret it?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I have more regrets than I can count,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: coming to the Outer Rim has never been one of them. I swear it.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Admit that what we did was wrong,

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: and cast off your past life.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That's the price you have to pay.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: You're a traitor and a hypocrite...!

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: I'll carry my share of sin with me.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Where was he hiding the detonator?!

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: We'll never be making it to heaven anyway,

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: so I'll see you in hell along with the others, Boss.

lines.speaker: mellen
lines.text: Light is our right! Heavenly Ascension!
